name: kn-corporate-income-tax
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis corporation tax for 2026 under the Income Tax Act, Cap. 20.22. Covers who is charged (companies only; resident companies on worldwide income and non-resident companies on income of a local permanent establishment, s.3A from Act 12 of 2021), the rate conflict (33% in s.32(1)(b) and the IRD instalment FAQ against the 25% from 1 January 2024 announced in the 2024 budget), the return 3.5 months after year end (15 April 2026 for a 31 December 2025 year end), quarterly instalments on the 15th of March, June, September and December, the 25% understatement penalty, and the CIT-101 information return for international companies and Nevis entities. Trigger phrases include St Kitts corporate tax, Nevis company tax rate, CIT-100, CIT-101, St Kitts income tax return.
